sentences: The warship Temeraire, which had helped protect Nelson's flagship at the Battle of Trafalgar in 1805, is being towed up the Thames to be broken up for scrap.
Leading her is a squat, dark steam tug.
Turner placed the tug's funnel in front of its mast so that the black smoke drifts back past the pale, ghostly masts of the old sailing ship.
A blazing sunset fills the right side of the sky, and a faint crescent moon rises at the upper left.
The whole sky becomes a picture of the age of sail giving way to the age of steam.
Turner called the painting his darling, refused to sell it and left it to the nation.
In 2005 it was voted Britain's favorite painting, and it now appears on the Bank of England's £20 note.
